change_summary: PLOS ONE issued an expression of concern about this paper. The issues are an apparent discontinuity in the Fig. 4 LSD1 blot and a Fig. 7 that does not match its legend and text. The editors also note missing control detail for the transfection experiments and similarities to other groups' work that question the validity and provenance of the results. The authors did not respond, so the issues are unresolved.
evaluation: Your draft cites the paper in Section 2 for higher LSD1 in tumour tissue and its link to shorter survival, and in Section 3 as the main evidence that LSD1 knockdown slows H460 migration (its Figure 7). The expression of concern names Fig. 7 as not matching its legend and text, and says the transfection controls are insufficiently described, so the Section 3 rationale is touched. The Section 2 tissue and survival use is not among the flagged parts. Overall the impact is moderate, since your plan's central hypothesis leans on this result, though your Aim 2 is designed to test it independently.
recommendation: Hedge the Section 3 sentence that treats the knockdown result as the clearest indication of LSD1 driving migration, because the notice says the results shown in Fig. 7 do not match its legend and text and that the transfection controls are insufficiently described. The Section 2 tissue and survival citation can stay.

affected_parts.findings_affected: LSD1 expression is lower in A549 than in H460, the basis for using Flag-LSD1 in A549 and siRNA in H460

affected_parts.part: Fig. 7 and the scratch-assay result for LSD1 siRNA in H460 cells
affected_parts.findings_affected: LSD1 knockdown reduces migration of H460 cells

affected_parts.part: Flag-LSD1 and LSD1 siRNA transfection experiments
affected_parts.findings_affected: Proliferation, migration and invasion effects of LSD1 over-expression and knockdown, which cannot be replicated from the reported control detail

alerts.reason: An expression of concern about figures, controls and the validity of results puts the findings in doubt, and the issues are unresolved because the authors did not respond. It is not a retraction.

evidence.quote: there appears to be a vertical discontinuity in the LSD1 panel between the 293T and A549 lanes.
